summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks.
takeaways: Over the past years, research on agentic graphics has expanded rapidly across a diverse range of tasks.
Second, we develop an agentic literature system that can assist human researchers in analyzing existing and newly published papers at scale.
This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks.
